more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Chlorine dioxide is a defined chlorine oxide used in controlled food-processing treatments. FDA specifies preparation, residual limits and use conditions for applications such as washing certain produce and poultry-processing use. The US flour standard separately lists it for flour bleaching and artificial ageing. These different processing applications have different conditions and do not define a single ordinary dietary dose.
